content.text:
=== BEGIN ARTIFACT TOPOLOGY.md ===
## Declarations

## story foundation
summary:      Stand up the Go module, directory layout and test runner every other story builds into.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   ARCHITECTURE.md
stack:        common.md, go.md
provides:     go.mod, internal/, cmd/ddkstat/
instructions: |
  Create the root go.mod (module path ddkstat, Go 1.22 or newer, no require lines), the cmd/ddkstat
  and internal/ directories, and bin/. Use only the standard library; no database; no third-party module.

  ARCHITECTURE.md fixes the package ownership every later story follows:
  internal/logread (parse, validate, dedupe, normalize records), internal/filter (pure record filters),
  internal/format (minutes and cost text), internal/report (one aggregate-and-write function per report),
  internal/cli (Run(args []string, stdout, stderr io.Writer) int, option parsing, report registry).
  Only cmd/ddkstat/main.go calls os.Exit. Pipeline order: parse arguments, read log, drop skipped and
  duplicate lines, filter, aggregate, format.
acceptance:   yes

## story log-lines
summary:      Read the JSON Lines log into records, ignoring blank lines and classifying failed calls.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-LogLines.md
covers:       LOG-001
stack:        go.md
provides:     logread.Read, logread.Record
consumes:     go.mod
depends:      foundation
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  In internal/logread, read the log with bufio.Reader (no fixed line-length limit), one JSON object per
  physical line. A line that is empty after trimming whitespace is blank: ignored and not counted, but it
  still advances the physical line number. Decode each object into a Record carrying execution_id,
  started_at, status, command, target, provider (job.llm), requested model, executed model, token counts,
  cost, elapsed_ms, returncode (nullable), timed_out. A Record is Failed when status is not "succeeded".
  Date is the first 10 characters of started_at. Required Go tests: TestReadBlankLines, TestReadFailedStatus,
  TestReadStartDate.

## story log-skip
summary:      Skip malformed, incomplete and duplicate lines with a stderr warning and no effect on the exit code.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-LogSkip.md
covers:       LOG-002
accepts:      st-004
stack:        go.md
provides:     logread.Read skip rules, logread.Result.Skipped
consumes:     logread.Read
depends:      log-lines
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Extend logread.Read to return the kept records plus a whole-file skipped count. Skip a line when it is not
  a JSON object, when any of execution_id, started_at, status, job.command_name, job.target is absent or not
  a non-empty string, or when its execution_id was already registered by an earlier kept line. A skipped line
  writes one warning to the supplied warning writer naming its 1-based physical line number (blank lines
  count toward numbering). A malformed line never registers its execution_id. Duplicate detection runs over
  the whole file before any filter. Required Go tests: TestSkipNotObject, TestSkipMissingField,
  TestSkipDuplicateKeepsFirst, TestMalformedDoesNotRegisterID, TestSkipWarningLineNumber.

## story log-numbers
summary:      Treat absent, null or non-numeric token, cost and duration values as zero.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-LogNumbers.md
covers:       LOG-003
stack:        go.md
provides:     logread.Record numeric normalization
consumes:     logread.Read
depends:      log-skip
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Normalize input_tokens, cached_input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd and elapsed_ms: absent, null, or a
  value of the wrong JSON type counts as zero. A record with no result.stats object remains a record, and a
  null or absent result.returncode is represented as no returncode. Required Go tests: TestNumbersAbsentAreZero,
  TestNumbersNullAreZero, TestNumbersNonNumericAreZero, TestNoStatsObjectStillRecord.

## story log-model
summary:      Attribute each record to the executed model, falling back to the requested model.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-LogModel.md
covers:       LOG-004
accepts:      st-007
stack:        go.md
provides:     logread.Record.Model
consumes:     logread.Read
depends:      log-skip
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Record.Model is result.stats.model when present and non-empty, otherwise job.model. Required Go tests:
  TestModelPrefersExecuted, TestModelFallsBackWhenAbsent, TestModelFallsBackWhenEmpty,
  TestModelFallsBackWithoutStats.

## story cli-args
summary:      Parse the report name, options and log path into a validated invocation.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CliArgs.md
covers:       CLI-001
stack:        go.md
provides:     cli.ParseArgs
consumes:     go.mod
depends:      foundation
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  In internal/cli, ParseArgs(args) returns Options{Report, Target, Since, Until, LogPath} or a usage error.
  The first argument is the report and must be one of summary, commands, targets, models, daily, failures.
  Then come --target, --since, --until each taking one value, then exactly one log path. Use a hand-rolled
  or local flag.FlagSet parser with ContinueOnError. An option before the report name, an unknown report or
  option, a missing option value, a missing log path, or an extra positional argument is a usage error.
  A repeated option takes its last value. Required Go tests: TestParseReportAndLog, TestParseOptions,
  TestParseRepeatedOptionLastWins, TestParseOptionBeforeReportIsUsageError, TestParseUnknownReport,
  TestParseUnknownOption, TestParseMissingValue, TestParseLogPathCount.

## story cli-dates
summary:      Validate --since and --until as real YYYY-MM-DD calendar dates.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CliDates.md
covers:       CLI-002
stack:        go.md
provides:     cli.ParseArgs date validation
consumes:     cli.ParseArgs
depends:      cli-args
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  A date option value must parse with time.Parse("2006-01-02") and round-trip to the same text; 2026-13-01,
  2026-02-30, "2026-1-5" and empty values are usage errors. Valid dates pass through unchanged. Required Go
  tests: TestDateValid, TestDateInvalidMonth, TestDateInvalidDay, TestDateWrongShape, TestDateMissingValue.

## story filter-target
summary:      Filter records by exact job.target match.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-FilterTarget.md
covers:       FLT-001
accepts:      st-006
stack:        go.md
provides:     filter.ByTarget
consumes:     logread.Record
depends:      log-numbers, log-model
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Pure function in internal/filter: ByTarget(records, name) keeps records whose Target equals name exactly
  (case-sensitive); an empty name means no target filter was given. Required Go tests: TestByTargetExact,
  TestByTargetCaseSensitive, TestByTargetNoMatch, TestByTargetUnset.

## story filter-dates
summary:      Filter records by inclusive start-date range.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-FilterDates.md
covers:       FLT-002
accepts:      st-006
stack:        go.md
provides:     filter.ByDateRange
consumes:     logread.Record
depends:      log-numbers, log-model
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Pure function in internal/filter: ByDateRange(records, since, until) keeps records whose Date is >= since
  and <= until, both inclusive, compared as strings; an empty bound is unset. since later than until yields an
  empty result without error. Required Go tests: TestSinceInclusive, TestUntilInclusive, TestRangeBothBounds,
  TestSinceAfterUntilEmpty, TestBoundsUnset.

## story cli-exit
summary:      Assemble the Run pipeline and map failures to exit codes 0, 1 and 2.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CliExit.md
covers:       CLI-003
accepts:      st-008
stack:        go.md
provides:     cli.Run, cli.Register
consumes:     cli.ParseArgs, logread.Read, filter.ByTarget, filter.ByDateRange
depends:      cli-dates, log-numbers, log-model, filter-target, filter-dates
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement Run(args, stdout, stderr) int: ParseArgs; on usage error write one usage-summary line to stderr,
  nothing to stdout, return 2. Open and read the log (never write to it); if it cannot be opened or read write
  one diagnostic line to stderr, nothing to stdout, return 1. Otherwise read records, apply ByTarget then
  ByDateRange, and dispatch to the report writer registered under the report name in a registry map
  (cli.Register(name, fn) with fn(w io.Writer, records, skipped) error); each report story registers its own
  writer. An unregistered report writes nothing and returns 0 until its story lands. Skip warnings go to
  stderr. Report-writer errors return 1 with stdout untouched (buffer output and flush only on success).
  Required Go tests use bytes.Buffer: TestRunUsageErrorExit2, TestRunUsageErrorWritesNothingToStdout,
  TestRunMissingLogExit1, TestRunMissingLogWritesNothingToStdout, TestRunSkippedLinesStillExit0,
  TestRunFilterOrder.

## story value-format
summary:      Provide shared minutes and cost text formatters.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-ValueFormat.md
stack:        go.md
provides:     format.Minutes, format.Cost
consumes:     go.mod
depends:      foundation
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  In internal/format: Minutes(ms int64) string computes t = (ms + 3000) / 6000 in integer division and
  returns t/10, ".", t%10 (95000 ms is 1.6; 0 is 0.0). Cost(usd float64) string returns fmt.Sprintf("%.4f").
  Required Go tests: TestMinutesRounding (cases derived from the formula), TestMinutesZero, TestCostFourPlaces,
  TestCostZero.

## story report-summary
summary:      Write the one-row summary report.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-ReportSummary.md
covers:       SUM-001
stack:        go.md
provides:     ddkstat summary
consumes:     cli.Register, format.Minutes, format.Cost, logread.Record
depends:      cli-exit, value-format
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Header records,skipped,succeeded,failed,first,last,input_tokens,cached_tokens,output_tokens,cost_usd,minutes.
  One row over the filtered records; skipped is the whole-file count regardless of filters; first and last are the
  earliest and latest start dates (empty when no record matches); cost via format.Cost, minutes via
  format.Minutes. Aggregation and formatting are separate functions with Go tests. Register as "summary".
  Required Go tests: TestSummaryAggregate, TestSummaryEmptyFirstLast, TestSummarySkippedIgnoresFilters,
  TestSummaryWrite. Reachability check goes through drydock_go.cli_runner with a log written by the test.

## story report-commands
summary:      Write the commands report with a TOTAL row.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-ReportCommands.md
covers:       CMD-001
stack:        go.md
provides:     ddkstat commands
consumes:     cli.Register, format.Minutes, logread.Record
depends:      cli-exit, value-format
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Header command,calls,failed,input_tokens,cached_tokens,output_tokens,minutes. One row per command ordered by
  calls descending then command ascending (byte order), then TOTAL over all filtered records. An empty match
  writes the header and a TOTAL row of zeros with 0.0 minutes. Text values are written unquoted. Register as
  "commands". Required Go tests: TestCommandsOrdering, TestCommandsTotal, TestCommandsEmpty,
  TestCommandsWrite.

## story report-targets
summary:      Write the targets report with cost and a TOTAL row.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-ReportTargets.md
covers:       TGT-001
stack:        go.md
provides:     ddkstat targets
consumes:     cli.Register, format.Minutes, format.Cost, logread.Record
depends:      cli-exit, value-format
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Header target,calls,failed,input_tokens,cached_tokens,output_tokens,cost_usd,minutes. One row per target
  ordered by target ascending (byte order), then TOTAL. Empty match writes the header and a zero TOTAL
  (0.0000 cost, 0.0 minutes). Register as "targets". Required Go tests: TestTargetsOrdering,
  TestTargetsTotalCost, TestTargetsEmpty, TestTargetsWrite.

## story report-models
summary:      Write the models report grouped by provider and model with a TOTAL row.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-ReportModels.md
covers:       MOD-001
stack:        go.md
provides:     ddkstat models
consumes:     cli.Register, format.Cost, logread.Record
depends:      cli-exit, value-format
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Header provider,model,calls,failed,input_tokens,cached_tokens,output_tokens,cost_usd. One row per provider
  (job.llm) and Record.Model pair ordered by provider then model ascending (byte order), then a TOTAL row whose
  model column is empty (TOTAL,,...). Empty match writes the header and a zero TOTAL row. Register as "models".
  Required Go tests: TestModelsGroupingUsesExecutedModel, TestModelsOrdering, TestModelsTotalEmptyModelColumn,
  TestModelsEmpty, TestModelsWrite.

## story report-daily
summary:      Write the daily report with token totals and a TOTAL row.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-ReportDaily.md
covers:       DAY-001
stack:        go.md
provides:     ddkstat daily
consumes:     cli.Register, format.Minutes, logread.Record
depends:      cli-exit, value-format
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Header date,calls,failed,tokens,minutes. One row per start date ascending; tokens is input plus cached plus
  output tokens; then TOTAL. Empty match writes the header and a zero TOTAL row. Register as "daily". Required
  Go tests: TestDailyOrdering, TestDailyTokensSum, TestDailyTotal, TestDailyEmpty, TestDailyWrite.

## story report-failures
summary:      Write the failures report listing each failed record.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-ReportFailures.md
covers:       FAIL-001
stack:        go.md
provides:     ddkstat failures
consumes:     cli.Register, logread.Record
depends:      cli-exit, value-format
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Header started_at,target,command,model,returncode,timed_out. One row per failed record ordered by started_at
  then execution_id ascending (byte order). returncode is empty when null or absent; timed_out is true or false;
  model is Record.Model. No TOTAL row; an empty match writes the header only. Register as "failures". Required
  Go tests: TestFailuresOrdering, TestFailuresNullReturncodeEmpty, TestFailuresTimedOutText,
  TestFailuresOnlyFailed, TestFailuresEmpty.

## story build-exe
summary:      Wire the ddkstat main package and keep the module standard-library only.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-BuildExecutable.md
covers:       BLD-001
accepts:      st-003
stack:        go.md
provides:     cmd/ddkstat
consumes:     cli.Run
depends:      cli-exit
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  cmd/ddkstat/main.go is package main: os.Exit(cli.Run(os.Args[1:], os.Stdout, os.Stderr)) and nothing else.
  `go build ./cmd/ddkstat` from the module root must succeed and go.mod must declare no require lines.
  Acceptance builds through drydock_go.cli_runner and checks the exit status of an invocation with no
  arguments (usage error); it invokes no report command.

## story test-script
summary:      Provide bin/test.sh running go vet and go test.
type:         service
kind:         test harness
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-TestScript.md
covers:       BLD-002
accepts:      st-002
stack:        common.md, go.md
provides:     bin/test.sh
consumes:     go.mod
depends:      foundation
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  POSIX sh script bin/test.sh: set -eu, cd to the application root (derived from the script path), run
  `go vet ./...` then `go test ./...`, and exit zero only when both pass. No bashisms. Acceptance runs
  `sh bin/test.sh` and requires exit status 0.

## story verification
summary:      Run the supplied grader against the finished tool as the terminal gate.
type:         feature
kind:         integration
phase:        3
implements:   VERIFICATION.md
covers:       BLD-003
accepts:      st-001, st-005
stack:        go.md
consumes:     ddkstat summary, ddkstat commands, ddkstat targets, ddkstat models, ddkstat daily, ddkstat failures
depends:      report-summary, report-commands, report-targets, report-models, report-daily, report-failures, build-exe, test-script
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Assembly and intent only: every report, filter, skip rule and exit code is built by member stories. The
  staged sources/run.sh and sources/llm_sample.jsonl are present in the build directory unmodified. The
  terminal criterion declares Suite: full, runs `sh sources/run.sh` unfiltered, prints its captured output,
  and asserts exit status 0. If it fails, repair the member behavior, never the staged assets or any
  report answer.
=== END ARTIFACT ===

## story cli-exit
summary:      Assemble the Run pipeline and map failures to exit codes 0, 1 and 2.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CliExit.md
covers:       CLI-003
accepts:      st-008
stack:        go.md
provides:     cli.Run, cli.Register
consumes:     cli.ParseArgs, logread.Read, filter.ByTarget, filter.ByDateRange
depends:      cli-dates, log-numbers, log-model, filter-target, filter-dates
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement Run(args, stdout, stderr) int: ParseArgs; on usage error write one usage-summary line to stderr,
  nothing to stdout, return 2. Open and read the log (never write to it); if it cannot be opened or read write
  one diagnostic line to stderr, nothing to stdout, return 1. Otherwise read records, apply ByTarget then
  ByDateRange, and dispatch to the report writer registered under the report name in a registry map
  (cli.Register(name, fn) with fn(w io.Writer, records, skipped) error); each report story registers its own
  writer. An unregistered report writes nothing and returns 0 until its story lands. Skip warnings go to
  stderr. Report-writer errors return 1 with stdout untouched (buffer output and flush only on success).
  Required Go tests use bytes.Buffer: TestRunUsageErrorExit2, TestRunUsageErrorWritesNothingToStdout,
  TestRunMissingLogExit1, TestRunMissingLogWritesNothingToStdout, TestRunSkippedLinesStillExit0,
  TestRunFilterOrder.
